record.oneLiner: Business finance platform (cards, expenses, transactions, accounting) with a REST API for internal tools and workflows.
record.verdictReason: Official Brex MCP server (beta) supports OAuth and API tokens; the API token is generated by an account or card admin after accepting the Developer API agreement, with no separate approval step stated on the pages read. Requires an existing Brex account, and the MCP server is documented as beta.

evidence.quote: generate a user token from your Brex dashboard and pass it along in your API call headers
These must be accepted to use the developer API.
Brex APIs use the REST architecture, are defined using the OpenAPI specification
The server is hosted at https://api.brex.com/mcp and supports any MCP-compatible client.
